data.text:
Selection revision (2026-11-19), built and installed in the owner's pack (mods/memento-0.1.0+26.3.jar, 14:53). Uncommitted on branch time-sweep-spike.
- MomentScout: after 3 s standing still outdoors, casts 16 azimuths x 3 elevations (-6/0/+10 deg) rays, reach 160, 12 rays per tick.
- MomentScoring picks one of:
  - panorama: best 90 deg window, 0.45 depth + 0.25 open + 0.2 elevation + 0.1 relief; +40% for activity in view, +10% if the player faces it.
  - sunset: yaw 90, time 12500.
  - sunrise: yaw 270, time 23600.
- ActivityMap: block place/break per 16x16 column, 7-day half-life, saved to memento/activity/<kind>-<id>.json. No home detection.
- Dedupe: within 48 blocks and 45 deg, the higher score wins.
- F7 manual record removed; every background is automatic.
- Darkroom: scenic moments (cameraFov > 0) turn the player to face cameraYaw, back to the camera (pitch -6 at sun spots, +6 over views). Sun spots are developed at that time with clear weather.
- OPEN: the owner has not picked a framing yet (SMALL / THIRD / SHOULDER). Default is MementoConfig.framing = "third". Harness darkroom mode records all three at worldTicks 190; remove that once the owner chooses.
- Gotcha: framings recorded in the same millisecond collided on id; fixed with MomentRecorder.nextId().
